info.title: API.SH: Reclame AQUI
info.description: The Reclame AQUI API from API.SH: public Reclame AQUI data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's page on Reclame AQUI (reclameaqui.com.br, Brazil's consumer-complaint site): name, website, logo, cover, description, verified badge, total complaints, `reputation` for the last 6 months (status such as RA1000, Ótimo, Bom, Regular, Ruim or Não recomendada; score, consumer score, complaints, answered, not answered, evaluated, answered %, solved %, would-do-business-again %, average answer time in days, complaints in the last 30 days) and the same for every period in `reputation_periods` (6 and 12 months, last year, all time), CNPJ documents, public phones and emails, address, social links, main segment and segments, complaint categories and problem types the company handles, previous names, created and modified dates and `raw`. Unknown companies answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-company

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company shortname from its page link (reclameaqui.com.br/empresa/<shortname>/, e.g. `nubank`, `mercado-livre`, `ifood`) or the link itself.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One complaint on Reclame AQUI: title, full description, status (pending, answered, solved, not solved), solved, evaluated, would-do-business-again and the consumer's score, the company's answers and the consumer's replies and final evaluation in `interactions` (type ANSWER, REPLY, FINAL_ANSWER; date; message), category, problem and product types, city and state, created date, and the company with its logo, website, verified badge, complaint count, 6-month `reputation` and its position in its segment ranking. `latest=true` with `company` opens the newest complaint of that company. Removed complaints answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-complaint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The complaint id (`id` in complaints, e.g. `i4SRuQmIHsFFlpsI`) or its reclameaqui.com.br link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the newest complaint of `company` (and the other complaints filters).

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: the company shortname, e.g. `nubank`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A company's complaints with every filter of its complaint list: status (not answered, answered, evaluated, solved, not solved), category, product and problem ids (from `facets`), the special campaigns (Black Friday, Covid-19) and keywords; or, with `q` and no company, a search over every company's complaints. Each complaint: `id`, `title`, `url`, `description` (the first lines, the full text is on /reclameaqui/v1/complaint), `status`, `solved`, `evaluated`, `deal_again`, `score`, the consumer's evaluation, `company`, category, problem and product types, city, state, created and modified dates, the company's answers in `interactions` and `raw`. `facets` lists the categories, products and problems with counts. 10 complaints a page, up to 30 pages per filter set (narrow with filters for older complaints); `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-complaints

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company shortname (e.g. `nubank`), its reclameaqui.com.br/empresa/ link or its numeric id. Optional with `q`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords searched in the complaints (of the company, or of every company without `company`), e.g. `cartao`, `cobranca`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Which complaints.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from `facets.categories` (e.g. `0000000000000003` Cartões de Crédito). Needs company.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product id from `facets.products`. Needs company.

parameters.name: problem
parameters.description: Problem id from `facets.problems` (e.g. `0000000000000075` Cobrança indevida). Needs company.

parameters.name: special
parameters.description: Complaints filed during a campaign. Needs company.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The site's national company rankings (top 20): most complained about (yesterday, 7 days, 30 days, 6 months), companies that solved the most, best solution rate, best consumer ratings, worst companies, newly registered companies with the most complaints, and would do business again. Each row: position, company name, `shortname`, `url`, logo, reputation label and the ranked value (`value`, `value_text`, `value_label`). Also the list's title, its summary sentence and the update time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-rankings

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Which ranking.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period of the ranking: `most_complained` takes yesterday, 7_days, 30_days, 6_months; the others have one period each (the default).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Companies on Reclame AQUI matching a name (the site's own search box): `id`, `shortname` (for /reclameaqui/v1/company and complaints), name, `url`, logo, website, reputation status, score, solved %, complaints, verified badge, main segment, segment, city, state, CNPJ documents, sub-brands, previous names and `raw`. Up to 5 best matches, as on the site.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A company name, e.g. `banco`, `magazine luiza`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The best or worst companies of one segment (e.g. digital banks, airlines, e-commerce) as ranked by Reclame AQUI: position, company name, `shortname`, `url`, logo, website, reputation status (RA1000, GREAT, GOOD, REGULAR, BAD, NOT_RECOMMENDED...), verified badge, score, solved %, answered %, solved and unsolved complaints, balance and complaint count, segment names and `raw`. Segments come from /reclameaqui/v1/segments. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-segment-ranking

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: `<main segment>/<segment>` from /reclameaqui/v1/segments (e.g. `bancos-e-financeiras/bancos-digitais`) or its reclameaqui.com.br/segmentos/ link.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `best`, `worst` or `best_verified` (best among verified companies).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Companies per page, 1-50 (default 10).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every segment that has a company ranking on Reclame AQUI, grouped by main segment (about 45 main segments, several hundred segments): name, `segment` (the id for /reclameaqui/v1/segment-ranking) and its page `url`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reclameaqui-segments

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

segments.name: Call Centers e Serviços de Atendimento

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
